updates.title: City Events, joining and phasing
changes: City Event cards show the class, laps and Ranked before the grid opens, and say when you have no car for that class.
Join puts you in with the car you sit in when it fits the race. On foot or in the wrong car, the tablet says what to do.
Phasing is only between racers in the same race. Police and everyone else can still hit them.
Fixed: a new race flashing as gone, all-black track pictures, Global refusing tracks built with track-kit props, arena time trials from the garage and the garage computer's top bar.
City Event Counts For Rating now sits next to City Event Class. Update gg_lib to 1.0.24 for the Script Studio layout fixes.

updates.title: Racing System early access
changes: Street races, contracts and City Events across the map, a track builder with over 50 props, Global tracks every server shares, the Racing Garage with upgrades, arena races and arcade machines, all on one tablet.
